plan.summary: Feature A: a background reconciliation sweep in Outbound that points each allowlisted, WapCRM-configured tenant's cxapi MESSAGES webhook at our delivery-ack ingress ({PublicBaseUrl}/api/v1/webhook/event?companyId={tenant_id}) so delivery/read acks flow — backfilling existing configured tenants (5050, 100000001) and any future ones without manual panel/API steps.
plan.q_intent: FEATURE A — tenant wapcrm-config yazımında otomatik webhook-set (POST /api/webhook-settings/messages, companyId=tenant_id; trigger=config yazımı, mevcut configli tenant'lara backfill; sahip Outbound). Doküman: temp/invekto-api-webhook-settings-and-message-status-for-agents.md
plan.interview_notes: There is NO programmatic wapcrm-config write path (config is written by manual SQL), so there is no 'write moment' to hook. Q chose (1) a reconciliation SWEEP (startup + periodic, idempotent) over a write-trigger or one-shot backfill, and (2) do-not-clobber-foreign-URL + warn-log (only set when current is empty or already ours). Codex plan-consult (critique) added: dropped the in-memory confirmed-cache (drift-masking hazard; full reconcile every tick — tenant set is tiny); added an explicit allowlist gate (AllowAllConfigured flag + AllowedTenantIds, mirroring BulkSendOptions) so rollout scope is controlled, not just 'has a secret'; 'ours' is matched on host+path+companyId (not exact string) so a future PublicBaseUrl host migration does not self-classify the old URL as foreign; clear customHeaders:[] when we set (omitting would PRESERVE stale headers per the partner contract, not clear them); classify HTTP 509 IP-denial explicitly (INV-OB-093); never log full URLs or the secret (foreign log carries host only).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When enabled + allowlisted, the sweep sets a configured tenant's cxapi messages webhook to {PublicBaseUrl}/api/v1/webhook/event?companyId={tenant_id} with isActive=true when the current webhook is empty or already ours-but-inactive/old-host; it is idempotent (no redundant POST when already exactly ours + active).
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: CxapiWebhookReconcileJob.ReconcileTenantAsync: empty->SetAsync('empty'); owned+desired+active->return (no POST); owned+inactive/old-host->SetAsync; build PASS.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A tenant whose messages webhook points to a NON-Invekto (foreign) URL is left UNTOUCHED and warn-logged (INV-OB-092) with host only — never clobbered.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: IsOwnedWebhook returns false for a foreign host/path/companyId; the else branch logs INV-OB-092 with SafeHost(current) and performs no write.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Production-safe default OFF (Enabled=false) + explicit allowlist; the /events HMAC channel is NEVER touched (only /messages).
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Options.Enabled default false (StartAsync returns without scheduling); IsTenantAllowed gates on Enabled && (AllowAllConfigured || AllowedTenantIds.Contains). Client only ever calls GET /api/webhook-settings + POST /api/webhook-settings/messages; no /events path exists in the client.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Per-tenant isolation + no silent failure: one tenant's transport/timeout/509/provider fault never aborts the sweep; every failure is coded-logged (INV-OB-091/093) and retried next tick; the async-void Tick never crashes the process (typed catches only, no bare catch(Exception)); finally resets the overlap guard.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: ReconcileTenantAsync wraps each tenant in typed catches (OperationCanceledException/HttpRequestException); the client returns typed outcomes (no throw on provider/transport); Tick catches OperationCanceledException + NpgsqlException only and resets _isProcessing in finally.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared change is additive (new client + DTOs + 3 error constants, no existing type modified); full solution builds 0 errors.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: New WapCrmWebhookSettingsClient.cs + new INV-OB-091/092/093 constants only; full solution build 0 Error / 42 pre-existing Warning.

verification_questions.question: Can the reconcile job ever WRITE (clobber) a tenant's existing third-party messages webhook, given the partner's null-preserves customHeaders contract and the owned-vs-foreign decision?
Is the secret handled safely (per-request header only, never on DefaultRequestHeaders, never logged) and are foreign URLs logged without leaking the full URL or any token?
If a single tenant's GET/SET times out, returns 509, or throws, can it abort the whole sweep or crash the async-void Tick, or leave the _isProcessing overlap guard stuck at 1?

Is the feature truly inert in production until explicitly enabled (Enabled=false default), and is the rollout scope bounded by the allowlist rather than firing for every tenant that merely has a secret?

forbidden_areas: Backend /api/v1/webhook/event ingress (unchanged — we only point cxapi at it)
non_goals: Feature B (message-status pull in the Rapor drawer) — separate queued packet
DB-backed reconciliation status table / metrics infra (warn-coded logs are the visibility surface in this stack)
Cross-process advisory lock (Outbound is single-instance NSSM)
intentional_exclusions: No in-memory confirmed-cache (full reconcile each tick — avoids drift-masking; tenant set is tiny)
Prod enablement is a config step (Enabled=true + AllowedTenantIds on the server), not part of this code change — mirrors how CxapiSend was enabled

try_catch_locations: CxapiWebhookReconcileJob.Tick: typed OperationCanceledException + Npgsql.NpgsqlException (no bare catch(Exception)); finally resets _isProcessing
CxapiWebhookReconcileJob.ReconcileTenantAsync: typed OperationCanceledException (rethrow on shutdown) + OperationCanceledException (timeout) + HttpRequestException — per-tenant isolation

WapCrmWebhookSettingsClient.Get/SetMessageWebhookAsync: typed OperationCanceledException (rethrow on caller-cancel) + OperationCanceledException (timeout->Outcome.Timeout) + HttpRequestException (->Outcome.TransportError); JsonException->null envelope->Outcome.Unparseable
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every non-success path is coded-logged: reconcile call failures INV-OB-091, foreign-URL skip INV-OB-092 (host only), 509 IP-denial INV-OB-093. A failed tenant is NOT marked done (no confirmed-cache) so it is retried next tick. The client returns typed outcomes rather than swallowing exceptions; the only swallowed thing is a JsonException mapped to an explicit Unparseable outcome (logged). No write happens on any non-Ok read outcome.

aha_moments.user_pain: Every new WapCRM tenant needed someone to remember to set the cxapi ack-webhook by hand (panel or one-off API), and Medipol's panel attempt silently never persisted — so delivery/read acks just didn't arrive.
aha_moments.suggestion: A reconciliation sweep that self-heals the webhook for every allowlisted configured tenant at startup + on an interval.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A tenant's acks start flowing without anyone touching the panel — and stay correct even if the webhook drifts.

aha_moments.user_pain: When acks weren't arriving, support had no signal whether the webhook was missing, foreign, or just inactive.
aha_moments.suggestion: Coded logs: INV-OB-092 names a tenant whose webhook points somewhere foreign; INV-OB-093 names a 509 IP-whitelist gap.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The log line tells support exactly which tenant is mis-wired and why, instead of guessing.

aha_moments.user_pain: Auto-managing a partner webhook risks silently overwriting a customer's own integration URL.
aha_moments.suggestion: Owned-vs-foreign match on host+path+companyId; foreign URLs are left untouched, only warned.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The job is safe to leave on — it can fix our own wiring but will never clobber a customer's.

aha_moments.user_pain: Onboarding a tenant for live cxapi delivery tracking was a multi-step manual checklist.
aha_moments.suggestion: Add the tenant id to the allowlist (or flip AllowAllConfigured) and the webhook is set within one sweep.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Go-live for ack tracking is now one config line, not a panel walkthrough.

aha_moments.user_pain: A future host migration (services.invekto.com -> api.invekto.com) would make every existing webhook look 'foreign' and get abandoned.
aha_moments.suggestion: Treat any host in OwnedWebhookHosts as ours and normalize to the new desired URL.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A domain migration becomes a config change the sweep rolls out automatically, with zero foreign-flag false alarms.

verdict.raw_text: iter0 FAIL (CQ9 cross-tenant query w/o tenant_id; CQ12 INV-OB codes not in arch/errors.md; Q3 unexpected typed exception could escape async-void Tick) -> iter1 fixes: (CQ9) registered the background/hosted-sweep sanctioned exception in arch/codex-context.md with in-prod precedents (FetchPendingOutboxBatchAsync/ResetSendingMessagesAsync); (CQ12) registered INV-OB-091/092/093 in arch/errors.md; (Q3) client header-attach throw -> typed TransportError outcome so the awaited surface is exactly {OperationCanceledException, HttpRequestException}, both caught -> nothing escapes Tick. Codex PASS 12/12 CQ + 4/4 CoVe, model gpt-5.5.
